description: Sign up for a 30-day Free Trial and get access to this and 20+ ZoomCharts visuals.Discover the power of Drill Down Combo PRO (Filter) for exceptional data visualizations. With multiple chart types to choose from, including line, area, and column charts, it's easy to create impactful reports. Used by 80% of Fortune 200 companies, Drill Down Combo PRO (Filter) simplifies report exploration for all Power BI users and lets you uncover insights effortlessly with interactive drill downs and on-chart interactions that accompany your line, area, and column charts. MAIN FEATURES: "Others" column - set the number of categories visible, the rest will be grouped together for better overall experience on analysis On-chart interactions – click, pan, zoom-in/out to explore multiple drill-down levels for column, line, and area charts Multiple chart types – choose between column, line, and area chart for each series Stacking and clustering – stack or cluster series, chose between series specific or cumulative (total) values Static and dynamic thresholds – set up to 3 thresholds to demonstrate targets or benchmarks on your column, line, and area charts Full customization – customize X and Y axes, legends, stacks, tooltip, fill settings, outlines Cross-chart filtering – select data points on multiple charts instead of using slicers Multi-touch device friendly – get equal experience on any device…
